item.title: Wordpress for Beginners - Master Wordpress
item.dc:creator: wakaraadmin
item.content:encoded: Are you new to PHP or need a refresher? Then this course will help you get all the fundamentals of Procedural PHP, Object Oriented PHP, MYSQLi and ending the course by building a CMS system similar to WordPress, Joomla or Drupal. Knowing PHP has allowed me to make enough money to stay home and make courses like this one for students all over the world. Being a PHP developer can allow anyone to make really good money online and offline, developing dynamic applications. Knowing PHP will allow you to build web applications, websites or Content Management systems, like WordPress, Facebook, Twitter or even Google. There is no limit to what you can do with this knowledge. PHP is one of the most important web programming languages to learn, and knowing it, will give you SUPER POWERS in the web development world and job market place. Why? Because Millions of websites and applications (the majority) use PHP. You can find a job anywhere or even work on your own, online and in places like freelancer or Odesk. You can definitely make a substantial income once you learn it. I will not bore you :) I take my courses very seriously but at the same time I try to make it fun since I know how difficult learning from an instructor with a monotone voice or boring attitude is. This course is fun, and when you need some energy to keep going, you will get it from me. My Approach Practice, practice and more practice. Every section inside this course has a practice lecture at the end, reinforcing everything with went over in the lectures. I also created a small application the you will be able to download to help you practice PHP. To top it off, we will build and awesome CMS like WordPress, Joomla or Drupal.
item.excerpt:encoded: This course will guide you through every single step from installation to finished website. I\'ll show you how you can install Wordpress on your own computer for free, so you don\'t have to pay for a domain name or hosting fees while you complete this course. Once you\'ve got Wordpress installed on your computer, you will learn how to build and run a successful, beautiful, responsive-design website you can be proud of.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Know how to configure Wordpress for best results Understand plugins & themes and how to find/install them Protect their Wordpress website from hackers and spammers Create a static homepage useful for most websites, or a blog like homepage useful for bloggers. Create an affiliate site for passive, recurring income Create a Responsive Website that looks good on any browser

No prior knowledge of Wordpress is required as everything will be covered in this course. You will need a working computer and a web browser connected to the internet.. You don't need any coding experience at all. That is the beauty of Wordpress.

If you want to learn Wordpress without paying for a web host, this course is perfect. I'll show you how you can install Wordpress on your very own computer while you learn. This course is for you if you want to build a website, whether for personal or business reasons. If you want to learn to master Wordpress without getting bogged down with technical jargon, this course is for you. If you want to get step-by-step, over-the-shoulder tuition from an ex-school teacher who has been using and teaching Wordpress since 2004. This course is perfect for you if you are taking over an existing Wordpress website, or want to build one from scratch, but don't know where to start. This course is for anyone that wants to be the Wordpress goto guy or gal.
7.5 hours on-demand video 10 articles 31 downloadable resources Full lifetime access Access on mobile and TV Certificate of Completion

wp:comment.wp:comment_content: Will my question join others to create a FAQ?

Excellent feel good fit for my I study and install accounting software. However wow a lot of stuff covered here. For me great. For a lot of others beginners may be a little over whelming. Again for me extremely helpful. I study software in chunks.

Very good course, great structure, really easy to follow. Have gone back and forth many times to check on some issues arising on my site. Also very handy to see what kind of plugins are available to serve different purposes.

This was my first time taking an online course. The content is excellent, and the instructors are also excellent. How much you learn from this course is pretty much what you put into it.

item.dc:creator: wakaraadmin
item.content:encoded: Are you new to PHP or need a refresher? Then this course will help you get all the fundamentals of Procedural PHP, Object Oriented PHP, MYSQLi and ending the course by building a CMS system similar to WordPress, Joomla or Drupal. Knowing PHP has allowed me to make enough money to stay home and make courses like this one for students all over the world. Being a PHP developer can allow anyone to make really good money online and offline, developing dynamic applications. Knowing PHP will allow you to build web applications, websites or Content Management systems, like WordPress, Facebook, Twitter or even Google. There is no limit to what you can do with this knowledge. PHP is one of the most important web programming languages to learn, and knowing it, will give you SUPER POWERS in the web development world and job market place. Why? Because Millions of websites and applications (the majority) use PHP. You can find a job anywhere or even work on your own, online and in places like freelancer or Odesk. You can definitely make a substantial income once you learn it. I will not bore you :) I take my courses very seriously but at the same time I try to make it fun since I know how difficult learning from an instructor with a monotone voice or boring attitude is. This course is fun, and when you need some energy to keep going, you will get it from me. My Approach Practice, practice and more practice. Every section inside this course has a practice lecture at the end, reinforcing everything with went over in the lectures. I also created a small application the you will be able to download to help you practice PHP. To top it off, we will build and awesome CMS like WordPress, Joomla or Drupal.
item.excerpt:encoded: Do you want to learn the number #1 programming language that powers the internet? Are you tired of wasting your time and money on random youtube videos or JavaScript courses that are either too simple, or too difficult to follow? Or are you struggling to deeply understand and apply JavaScript to real projects? If your answer is a big YES... Then this is exactly the course you are looking for!

A true understanding of how JavaScript works behind the scenes What's new in ES6: arrow functions, classes, default and rest parameters, etc. Practice your new skills with coding challenges (solutions included) Organize and structure your code using JavaScript patterns like modules Get friendly and fast support in the course Q&A Downloadable lectures, code and design assets for all projects

No coding experience is necessary to take this course! I take you from beginner to expert! Any computer and OS will work — Windows, macOS or Linux. We will set up your text editor the course. A basic understanding of HTML and CSS is a plus, but not a must! The course includes a 5-minutes HTML and CSS crash course.

Take this course if you want to gain a deep understanding of the most popular programming language in the world: JavaScript. Take this course if you have taken other JavaScript courses but: 1) still don't really understand JavaScript, or 2) still don't feel confident to code real-world apps. This course is perfect for you! Take this course if you're interested in using popular libraries/frameworks like React, Angular or Node. Take this course if you want to get started with programming in general: JavaScript is a great language to learn how to code.
18 hours on-demand video 10 articles 1 downloadable resource Full lifetime access Access on mobile and TV Certificate of Completion

Amazing Tutor, Many thanks for the course. You have explained the course so nicely. I thoroughly enjoyed the course and will be looking forward to your new courses.

item.title: AI SKILLS FOR KIDS [AGES 7-9]
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Children are growing up surrounded by artificial intelligence, from phones and social media to school tools and games.
Yet most children are never taught how AI works, how it learns, or how to use it responsibly.

AI Skills for Kids fills this gap by helping learners understand AI clearly, think critically about technology, and develop strong ethical foundations - without requiring coding, expensive devices, or constant internet access.

Grades 1–3 (Ages 7–9)

Learning Goal

Understand what AI is, how it helps people, and how humans stay in control.

Core Skills

  • Pattern recognition
  • Following instructions (algorithms)
  • Asking good questions
  • Kind & ethical use of technology

Key Topics

  • What is a machine?
  • What is intelligence?
  • Humans vs machines
  • Step-by-step thinking

Ages 7–9: AI Awareness

Learners explore:

  • What machines can and cannot do
  • Patterns and instructions
  • Kind and helpful technology

Outcome: Curiosity, confidence, ethical awareness

item.title: AI Beginners Workbook
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Hello and welcome to your very own AI Workbook! This book will help you learn about Artificial Intelligence (AI) - the technology that lets machines think and act in ways that seem smart.

We’ll explore:

  • What AI is and why it’s important in Africa.
  • Creative ways to use AI for art and music.
  • How AI can help you with research and coding.
  • How to stay safe and ethical when using AI tools.

item.title: ROBOTICS 101
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
The course aims to introduce young learners to foundational concepts in robotics and coding through engaging hands-on activities and problem-solving projects. By fostering creativity, critical thinking, and collaboration, this curriculum makes complex topics accessible and enjoyable for children.

Through hands-on projects, students will develop valuable skills in technology, electronic circuit assembly for robotics, basic coding, and critical thinking. These foundational skills will prepare them for future opportunities in STEM fields and instil a sense of curiosity and innovation that will serve them throughout their educational journeys

item.title: Lesson 1: AI in Everyday Life
item.dc:creator: wakaraadmin
item.content:encoded:
Overview
AI is not just science fiction; it’s part of your daily life! In this lesson, you’ll discover how artificial intelligence appears in tools you already use.

Examples:

  • Voice assistants (e.g., Siri, Alexa, Google Assistant)
  • Video or music recommendations (YouTube, Netflix, Spotify)
  • Simple games or filters on phones

Activity (Optional):
Watch this short explainer video:
(Link here)

Reflection Prompt:
Can you think of 3 more places where AI shows up in your life? Could you write them down?

Assignment (optional): Submit a short paragraph: “Where I see AI every day”.

item.title: Lesson 2 - Spotting AI: Activity
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Overview
Now that you’ve seen how AI shows up in everyday life, let’s test your detective skills!

Activity:
Look at these scenarios and decide: “AI or Not AI?”

  1. A calculator solves 25 × 12.
  2. Netflix recommends the next movie.
  3. A friend reminds you of homework.
  4. Google Maps suggests the fastest route.

Challenge: Take the quiz in the section

Or try this game https://sightengine.com/ai-or-not?version=2024Q3

Reflection Prompt:
Which example surprised you most? Why?

Lesson type: Quiz/Assignment
Assignment idea: Research other examples

item.title: Lesson 3 - How Simple Chatbots Work
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Overview
Chatbots seem smart, but most are built from simple rules: “If the user says this, then reply with that.”

Mini-Activity:
Try out a block-based chatbot builder, such as Scratch or MIT App Inventor.

  • How to build a chatbot with Scratch

Example Flow:

  • If someone types “Hi”, the bot says “Hello!”
  • If someone asks, “What’s your name?”, the bot says, “I’m RoboHelper.”

Reflection:
Imagine you’re designing a chatbot for your school. What would it help students with?

Lesson type: Practical / External link
Assignment: Describe one chatbot idea in a short paragraph.

item.title: Lesson 4- Ethics: A Short Story & Reflection
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Overview
AI is powerful, but it raises big questions. Let’s think about ethics.

Short Story:
A robot guard dog sees two kids: one sneaking into school without a uniform, and another who has fallen and needs help.
The robot must choose: chase the uniform violator OR help the injured child.

Discussion Questions:

  • What should the robot do first?
  • Is that choice fair to everyone? Why or why not?

Reflection Prompt:
Write 3–4 sentences sharing what you think is the “most fair” choice.

Lesson type: Text + Reflection
Assignment idea: Students submit their reflections in writing or audio.

A robot does not think like a human. It follows the steps.

🧪 Activity
Imagine your friend is a robot.
Give step-by-step instructions to:
Wash hands
Brush teeth
Pack a school bag


✍🏽 Reflection
What happened when instructions were unclear?
💡 Remember
AI only does what humans tell it to do.

item.title: Advanced Activity: “Visual Coding Robot”
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Tools (Choose one):

  • Scratch Jr
  • Scratch (simple blocks)
  • Blockly-based tools

 

🖥️ Setup (Before Class – 5 Minutes)

  1. Open the tool on all devices
  2. Create a new blank project
  3. Choose one simple character (sprite)

Activity

Step 1: Meet the Robot 

“This character is a robot.
It will only do exactly what we tell it.”

Step 2: Give One Instruction 

drag one movement block:

  • Move forward
  • Turn left
  • Turn right

Click Play.

Learning:

  • What did the robot do?
  • Did it do anything else?

Step 3: Create a Sequence

drag 3–5 blocks in a row:

  1. Move forward
  2. Turn right
  3. Move forward

Click Play.

Learning:

  • Did the robot follow the order?
  • What happens if we change the order?

Step 4: Break It on Purpose

  • Remove one block
  • Change the order
  • Add an extra turn

Click Play again.

Learning:

  • What went wrong?
  • Did the robot fix the mistake?

🧠 Key insight:
The robot doesn’t know what we meant — only what we told it.

Step 5: Complete a Simple Task

“Move the robot to the star.”

Tasks: 

  • Plan steps before dragging blocks
  • Test
  • Fix mistakes

🧠 Reflection

  • Why did the robot get confused?
  • What helped it succeed?
  • Who is responsible when it fails?

item.title: Spot the Pattern
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
🧠 Key Idea
Patterns help computers guess what comes next.

🧪 Activity
Look at this pattern:

🍎 🍌 🍎 🍌 🍎 ___

What comes next?

Draw your own pattern.

item.title: Advanced Activity: “Pattern Game Creator”
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Tools:

  • Scratch (simple blocks)
  • Codingame (kids mode)

Activity

Steps

  1. Open Scratch → New project
  2. Choose shapes or sprites
  3. Create a repeating pattern (e.g. red–blue–red–blue)
  4. Pause the pattern
  5. Ask: “What comes next?”
  6. Reveal the answer

Reflection

  • How did the computer know what to repeat?
  • What happens if the pattern changes?

item.title: Kind or Unkind Technology ❤️
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
🧠 Key Idea
Humans decide how technology is used.

🧪 Activity
Is this kind or unkind?

  • A robot helps clean a classroom
  • A robot insults people

Discuss with your teacher or parent.

💡 Remember
Kind technology helps people.

item.content:encoded:
• AI is being used in banks, phones, hospitals, and even on farms to help produce more food.
  • Understanding AI can open up many exciting career opportunities.
  • You can use AI to create solutions for your community.

item.title: Chapter 1: What Is Artificial Intelligence?
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Definition and Key Concepts

  • Data: Information that we feed into AI systems.
  • Algorithm: A set of rules or steps a computer follows to solve a problem.
  • Machine Learning: The part of AI where computers “learn” from data.

Real-Life Examples of AI Around Us

  • Chatbots: Answering customer questions online.
  • Recommendation Systems: Suggesting videos or music to you (like on YouTube or Spotify).
  • Virtual Assistants: Google Assistant, Siri, etc.

  • Fun Facts About AI

    • Many languages in Africa are being preserved using AI translations.
    • Drones powered by AI can help deliver medicine to remote villages.

item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Core AI Careers

CareerWhat They DoExample Work
AI EngineerBuild intelligent systems that allow computers to learn and make decisions.Chatbots, recommendation systems, smart assistants
Machine Learning EngineerDesign algorithms that help computers learn from data automatically.Image recognition, fraud detection
Data ScientistStudy large sets of data to discover patterns and insights.Predict trends, analyze customer behavior
AI Research ScientistExplore new ideas and technologies that improve artificial intelligence.Develop new AI models and algorithms
Robotics EngineerDesign and program robots that perform tasks automatically.Factory robots, delivery robots
Computer Vision EngineerBuild systems that allow computers to understand images and videos.Self-driving cars, facial recognition
Natural Language Processing (NLP) EngineerCreate systems that help computers understand human language.Chatbots, translation tools
AI Product ManagerLead teams that design and build AI-powered products.Planning features for AI apps
Automation EngineerDevelop systems that automate tasks normally done by humans.Warehouse robots, automated factories

Responsible AI Careers

 
CareerWhat They DoExample Work
AI EthicistEnsure AI systems are fair, safe, and used responsibly.Prevent bias in algorithms
AI Policy SpecialistHelp governments create rules and laws for safe AI use.AI regulations and governance
AI Safety ResearcherStudy how to make advanced AI systems safe and reliable.Risk analysis for AI systems
Privacy EngineerProtect people's data when AI systems collect information.Data protection systems

 

Creative AI Careers

CareerWhat They DoExample Work
AI Game DeveloperUse AI to make games more interactive and challenging.Smart game characters
AI ArtistUse AI tools to create digital art, music, and animations.AI-generated artwork
AI Content CreatorCreate videos, graphics, and stories using AI tools.Educational content, media production
AI Interaction DesignerDesign how humans interact with AI systems.Voice assistants, chatbot interfaces

AI in Science and Medicine

CareerWhat They DoExample Work
Health Technology SpecialistUse AI to support doctors and healthcare systems.Disease diagnosis tools
Bioinformatics ScientistUse AI to analyze biological and genetic data.DNA research
Medical Imaging SpecialistUse AI to analyze medical scans and images.Detect tumours in X-rays

AI in Agriculture and Environment

CareerWhat They DoExample Work
Agricultural TechnologistUse AI to improve farming and crop production.Smart irrigation systems
Precision Agriculture SpecialistUse drones and AI sensors to monitor crops.Crop health monitoring
Environmental Data ScientistUse AI to study climate and environmental data.Predict weather patterns

AI in Business and Industry

CareerWhat They DoExample Work
AI ConsultantHelp companies use AI to solve business problems.AI adoption strategies
AI TrainerTrain AI systems by labelling and organizing data.Training chatbots
Business Intelligence AnalystUse data and AI to help businesses make decisions.Market analysis

Emerging AI Careers

CareerWhat They DoExample Work
Prompt EngineerWrite instructions that help AI generate useful results.AI-generated content
AI Education SpecialistTeach people how to use AI technologies.AI training programs
AI Robotics TechnicianMaintain and repair AI-powered robots.Robot maintenance
Human-AI Collaboration DesignerDesign systems where humans and AI work together.AI copilots

item.title: Lesson Overview
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Generative AI can create images, music, stories, and more. In this lesson, students will explore how AI tools can generate artwork from text descriptions.

Using tools like DALL·E and Craiyon, learners will write simple prompts and generate unique AI artwork.

By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:

  1. Explain what Generative AI is.

  2. Use a text prompt to generate an image.

  3. Create digital art using AI tools.

  4. Improve prompts to produce better images.

item.title: What is Generative AI?
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Generative AI is a type of artificial intelligence that can create new content such as images, music, text, or videos.

Instead of only analysing data, generative AI produces something new based on instructions given by a user.

Example:

If you type:

"A robot painting a sunset over a futuristic city."

The AI will create an image based on that description.

AI Tools for Creating Art

Two popular tools that generate images from text include:

  • DALL·E 

  • Craiyon

These tools allow users to type a description (prompt) and generate artwork instantly.

Activity: Create Your Own AI Artwork

Instructions

  1. Open one of the AI image generators.

  2. Write a creative description (prompt) of an image you want.

  3. Click Generate.

  4. Review the images created by the AI.

  5. Choose your favorite image.

Example Prompts

Try prompts like:

  • A robot painting a picture in an art studio

  • A futuristic Nairobi city with flying cars

  • A lion wearing sunglasses in pop art style

  • An underwater classroom with students and a teacher

You can also add art styles, such as:

  • cartoon style

  • watercolor painting

  • digital art

  • realistic photography

item.title: Assignment
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Submit the following:

  1. Your AI-generated image.

  2. The prompt you used to create the image.

Welcome to the TInker with Me.

Spark Curiosity. Build the Future.

We believe every child has the potential to be a creator, an innovator, and a problem-solver. Through hands-on DIY projects in electronics , robotics , and artificial intelligence (AI) , we empower kids and teens to explore the world of technology in fun, engaging ways.

Explore Our Courses Browse Free Resources
Behind The Brand

About us

[elementor-element k="d7cddccf50028bccd4dff466ede49783" data=""]

The Courses we offer

Learn. Build. Innovate. Explore tech your way, at your pace

Kids Courses

Our kids’ courses ignite curiosity and creativity through playful, hands-on learning. From building their very first robot to exploring the basics of AI and electronics, children get a safe, supportive space to experiment, imagine, and create. Every lesson is designed to be fun, interactive, and inspiring — turning small sparks of interest into a lifelong passion for technology.

Read More

Teens Courses

For teens ready to level up, we offer challenging, project-based learning that blends advanced robotics, AI programming, and problem-solving. Students collaborate on real-world builds, develop critical thinking skills, and gain the confidence to bring bold ideas to life. These courses encourage exploration, innovation, and teamwork — preparing young innovators for the tech-driven future.

Read More

Adults Courses

Whether you’re learning tech for the first time or expanding your skills, our adult courses make robotics and AI approachable, practical, and rewarding. From hobbyist projects to career-oriented skills, you’ll discover how to apply technology creatively in everyday life. We keep learning flexible, engaging, and empowering — because it’s never too late to start tinkering.

Read More

Meet the Team

We are proud to have a team of passionate and dedicated mentors who are committed to nurturing the talents and aspirations of young innovators. Our experienced instructors bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise in the fields of robotics and electronics, ensuring that your child receives the best guidance and support on their educational journey.

Anne Salim

Product Manager, Entrepreneur, Consultant and Teacher, Anne curates the lessons on Tinkerwith_ for students to engage with electronics and robotics.

Success stories and Testimonials

My son went from just playing with gadgets to actually building his own! He’s so proud of the little robot he made, and I’ve never seen him this excited about learning.

Sarah M Parent of an 8-year-old

I always loved tech, but these courses showed me how to actually make things work. Now I’m working on a project that could enter our school’s science fair!

Taylor M Teen Student

I thought robotics was only for engineers, but Tinker With Me made it easy and fun. Now I’m building projects I never imagined I could do

Whitney R Adult

I built a robot that follows me around — and my friends think it’s the coolest thing ever!

Ethan R 10 year old

The AI course blew my mind. I went from zero coding knowledge to making my own chatbot in just a few weeks

Marissa Young Teen Student

Learning here feels like playing. Every project gives me a little win and a big smile

Daniel W Adult

Contact Us for Partnership Opportunities

We’d love to hear from you! Whether you have questions, feedback, or collaboration ideas, our team is here to help.

Learn more

item.dc:creator: wakaraadmin
item.content:encoded:
About us

Behind the brand

We’re not just about teaching; we’re about inspiring. Founded by educators and tech enthusiasts, TinkerWith.Store curates practical tools, step-by-step guides, and interactive lessons that make learning electronics, robotics, and AI accessible to everyone. From beginners who’ve never touched a circuit board to teens ready to code their first robot, our mission is simple: Turn curiosity into creation.

Success stories and Testimonials

My son went from just playing with gadgets to actually building his own! He’s so proud of the little robot he made, and I’ve never seen him this excited about learning.

Sarah M Parent of an 8-year-old

I always loved tech, but these courses showed me how to actually make things work. Now I’m working on a project that could enter our school’s science fair!

Taylor M Teen Student

I thought robotics was only for engineers, but Tinker With Me made it easy and fun. Now I’m building projects I never imagined I could do

Whitney R Adult

I built a robot that follows me around — and my friends think it’s the coolest thing ever!

Ethan R 10 year old

The AI course blew my mind. I went from zero coding knowledge to making my own chatbot in just a few weeks

Marissa Young Teen Student

Learning here feels like playing. Every project gives me a little win and a big smile

Daniel W Adult

item.title: Robotics
item.dc:creator: wakaraadmin
item.content:encoded:
Robotics

From Gears to Glory—Learn Robotics the Fun Way

Our step-by-step modules take you through the fundamentals of robotics, from mechanical structures to advanced automation. Whether you're interested in simple robotic movements or complex AI-driven robots, we provide the resources and guidance to help you innovate. Join us and turn your ideas into functional robotic creations!

Get Started

Robotics

Robots aren’t just science fiction—they’re part of our daily lives. At TinkerWith.Store, we teach kids and teens how to design, build, and program robots from scratch. Whether you want to compete in robotics challenges or simply bring your imagination to life, this page has everything you need to get started.

Why Learn Robotics?
  • Develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
  • Prepare for exciting careers in STEM fields.
Getting Started with Robotics Kits
  • Recommendations for beginner-friendly kits like LEGO Mindstorms, Arduino Starter Kits, and Makeblock mBot.
Free Robotics Tutorial
  • Learn how to program basic movements using block-based coding languages like Blockly.
  • Watch video tutorials on building simple robots like line-following bots and obstacle avoiders.
Advanced Robotics Challenges
  • Take on projects like creating a robotic arm, designing a drone, or programming autonomous vehicles.
Join the community
  • Connect with other young inventors through forums, workshops, and competitions hosted by TinkerWith.me.

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: wakaraadmin
item.content:encoded:
This is a sample page.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.

item.title: Connect the Electronics
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
1. Power the breadboard (Connect the positive and negative ports on the breadboard to the 5V and GND on the Arduino)
  2. Connect the LED lights on the breadboard (long leg is +/5V/Signal Pin, short leg is GND/- Connect the GND of the LED to a resistor and then to the blue line of the breadboard section that is powered. Each set of LEDs should all be on the same row for the GND. Connect the signal pin to ports on the Arduino.  Repeat the process for three sets of LEDs (Red, Yellow and Green)
  3. Connect the signal pins to the Arduino ports 
  4. Compile the code and upload it to the Arduino.
  5. Test the circuit
  6. Build the artwork

item.title: Upload the code
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Copy this code into your Arduino IDE Application or go to Arduino.cc, create an account, login, open new project then copy the code editor and save the project as traffic_lights

Cloud Arduino URL - app.arduino.cc

 

//CODE

const int R1 = 1;

const int Y1= 2;

const int G1 = 3;

const int R2 = 5; 

const int Y2= 6;

const int G2 = 7;

const int R3 = 8; 

const int Y3= 9;

const int G3 = 10;

const int R4 = 11; 

const int Y4= 12;

const int G4 = 13;

 

void setup()

{

  

  pinMode(R1, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(G1, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(Y1, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(R2, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(Y2, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(G2, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(R3, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(G3, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(Y3, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(R4, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(Y4, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(G4, OUTPUT);

}

 

void loop()

{

  digitalWrite(R1, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y1, LOW);

  digitalWrite(G1, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(R2, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(Y2, LOW);

  digitalWrite(G2, LOW);

  digitalWrite(R3, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y3, LOW);

  digitalWrite(G3, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(R4, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(Y4, LOW);

  digitalWrite(G4, LOW);

  delay(8000);

  digitalWrite(R1, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y1, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(G1, LOW);

  digitalWrite(R2, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y2, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(G2, LOW);

  digitalWrite(R3, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y3, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(G3, LOW);

  digitalWrite(R4, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y4, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(G4, LOW);

  delay(3000);

  digitalWrite(R1,HIGH);

  digitalWrite(Y1, LOW);

  digitalWrite(G1, LOW);

  digitalWrite(R2, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y2, LOW);

  digitalWrite(G2, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(R3, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(Y3, LOW);

  digitalWrite(G3, LOW);

  digitalWrite(R4, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y4, LOW);

  digitalWrite(G4,HIGH);

  delay(8000);

  digitalWrite(R1, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y1, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(G1, LOW);

  digitalWrite(R2, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y2, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(G2, LOW);

  digitalWrite(R3, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y3, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(G3, LOW);

  digitalWrite(R4, LOW);

  digitalWrite(Y4, HIGH);

  digitalWrite(G4, LOW);

  delay(3000);  

}

item.title: AI
item.dc:creator: wakaraadmin
item.content:encoded:
AI

Demystifying AI for Kids & Teens

Our step-by-step modules take you through the fundamentals of robotics, from mechanical structures to advanced automation. Whether you're interested in simple robotic movements or complex AI-driven robots, we provide the resources and guidance to help you innovate. Join us and turn your ideas into functional robotic creations!

Get Started

AI

Artificial Intelligence isn’t just for engineers, it’s for dreamers, thinkers, and creators like YOU! On this page, you’ll find curated resources designed to help young minds understand how AI works, why it matters, and how they can use it to solve real-world problems.

What is AI?
  • Learn the basics: What makes machines “smart”? How does AI think, learn, and adapt?
  • Explore everyday examples of AI, from voice assistants like Siri to self-driving cars.
Free AI Tools for Beginners
  • Try out platforms like Google Teachable Machine, Scratch with AI extensions, and IBM Watson Lite.
  • Hands-on tutorials to train your own AI models using simple drag-and-drop interfaces
Paid AI courses
  • Dive deeper with guided courses like “Intro to Machine Learning” and “Build Your First Chatbot.”
  • Perfect for teens eager to take their skills to the next level.
  •  
AI projects for Kids
  • Build a smart recycling bin that sorts trash automatically.
  • Create a virtual pet powered by AI emotions.

item.dc:creator: wakaraadmin
item.content:encoded:
Technology

Master the Tools That Shape Tomorrow

Our step-by-step modules take you through the fundamentals of robotics, from mechanical structures to advanced automation. Whether you're interested in simple robotic movements or complex AI-driven robots, we provide the resources and guidance to help you innovate. Join us and turn your ideas into functional robotic creations!

Get Started

Technology

Behind every great invention lies a foundation of knowledge in core technologies like circuits, sensors, microcontrollers, and more. This page is your gateway to understanding these building blocks—and applying them to create amazing projects

Electronics Basics
  • Understand components like resistors, capacitors, LEDs, and breadboards.
  • Experiment with simple circuits to light up bulbs and power motors.
Microcontroller Magic
  • Get introduced to popular platforms like Raspberry Pi, Arduino, and Micro:bit.
  • Follow along with tutorials to blink lights, control servos, and read sensor data.
  •  
Sensors and Actuators
  • Discover how temperature sensors, motion detectors, and ultrasonic modules work.
  • Use actuators like buzzers, fans, and stepper motors to add interactivity to your projects.
  •  
Tech Project Ideas
  • Build a weather station, create a smart home device, or develop a wearable gadget.
Curated Resource Library
  • Access free eBooks, schematics, and project blueprints to fuel your creativity.

item.title: Admission
item.dc:creator: wakaraadmin
item.content:encoded:
Admission

HOME / Admission

Email us

info@mail.com
support@mail.com

Visit us

34 Madison Street,
NY, USA 10005

Guides to undergraduate study

Doubling my 9–5 salary several times in my career is something I never thought would happen. My career went from startup land to call center operator in a short space of time.

That meant going from six-figures down to the minimum wage in my home country of Australia. And to top it off, I have no degrees in anything business related — unless you count a sound engineering qualification.

If an uneducated guy from the home of the Kangaroo can double their salary, there is definitely hope for you. Popular career websites like “Seek” suggest the typical advice about doing better in your performance review or getting more education from a university. This advice is out of date and I have watched many colleagues fall for this trap and only end up disappointed.

Doubling your salary, or at the very least increasing it significantly, is about breaking the norm and trying a few things that are a bit more radical as you’re about to see with these simple tips below.

 

The goal should be more than money

Okay so you can make more money but if that’s your only goal, the extra zeroes on your bank balance will get really boring real quick.

item.title: The Complete JavaScript Course 2019
item.dc:creator: wakaraadmin
item.content:encoded: Are you new to PHP or need a refresher? Then this course will help you get all the fundamentals of Procedural PHP, Object Oriented PHP, MYSQLi and ending the course by building a CMS system similar to WordPress, Joomla or Drupal. Knowing PHP has allowed me to make enough money to stay home and make courses like this one for students all over the world. Being a PHP developer can allow anyone to make really good money online and offline, developing dynamic applications. Knowing PHP will allow you to build web applications, websites or Content Management systems, like WordPress, Facebook, Twitter or even Google. There is no limit to what you can do with this knowledge. PHP is one of the most important web programming languages to learn, and knowing it, will give you SUPER POWERS in the web development world and job market place. Why? Because Millions of websites and applications (the majority) use PHP. You can find a job anywhere or even work on your own, online and in places like freelancer or Odesk. You can definitely make a substantial income once you learn it. I will not bore you 🙂 I take my courses very seriously but at the same time I try to make it fun since I know how difficult learning from an instructor with a monotone voice or boring attitude is. This course is fun, and when you need some energy to keep going, you will get it from me. My Approach Practice, practice and more practice. Every section inside this course has a practice lecture at the end, reinforcing everything with went over in the lectures. I also created a small application the you will be able to download to help you practice PHP. To top it off, we will build and awesome CMS like WordPress, Joomla or Drupal.

item.title: AI Skills for Kids Workbook - From Screen Time to Skill Time
item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
The hands-on workbook that turns your child into a confident creator using AI tools to write stories, build real projects, and discover skills they'll use for life. Designed for ages 8–16. No experience needed. Is your child spending hours scrolling - but not creating? This workbook changes that. The AI Skills for Kids Workbook is a fun, colourful, printable activity book that guides children step-by-step through the world of Artificial Intelligence. Instead of passively watching screens, your child will learn how to use AI tools to write stories, design characters, build real projects — and feel genuinely proud of what they've made. It's the kind of skill that lasts a lifetime.

───────────────────────────── ✅ WHAT'S INSIDE THE WORKBOOK ─────────────────────────────

🧠 Module 1 - Intro to AI Kid-friendly introduction to what AI is, what it can do, and how to use it safely. Includes a draw-your-own-robot activity, safety checklist, and a short quiz. 🎨 Module 2 - Create with AI Your child writes their first AI story using a guided prompt builder, designs their own superhero, and learns how to improve their ideas. Includes writing frames and reflection prompts. 🛠️ Module 3 - Build a Real Project From storybooks to how-to guides - your child plans and creates a mini project using AI + simple design tools. Includes a project planner, section templates, and a progress rating table. 💪 Module 4 - Confidence & Sharing Kids learn how to present their work, give and receive feedback, and celebrate what they've created. Includes a presentation planner and a Creator Card. 💰 Module 5 - Intro to Earning (Parent Loved!) A gentle, age-appropriate introduction to how creativity and skills can create real value. Includes real-life kid stories and a value-matching activity. 🎁 Bonus — Parent Guide A dedicated section for parents covering safe AI use, how to guide your child at home, and how to turn their new skills into opportunities. ───────────────────────────── 🙋 WHO IS THIS FOR? ───────────────────────────── ✔ Kids aged 8–16 who are curious about technology ✔ Parents who want screen time to be productive ✔ Homeschool families looking for digital literacy activities ✔ Schools and holiday programmes (bulk licences available) ✔ Kids who love to write, create, and build things ───────────────────────────── 📦 WHAT YOU GET ───────────────────────────── • Instant digital download (PDF - print at home or use on a tablet) • 5 full learning modules + bonus parent guide • Progress tracker with star chart • Writing frames, checklists, activity tables, and reflection prompts • Branded for easy printing on A4 paper • Lifetime access - reuse year after year ───────────────────────────── ❓ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS ───────────────────────────── Do my kids need AI experience? Not at all. The workbook starts from zero and builds confidence gradually. What AI tools do they need? The free version of ChatGPT is all that's needed. Canva (also free) is optional for Module 3. Is this safe for kids? Yes. Module 1 is dedicated entirely to AI safety. The parent guide also covers supervision tips. Can I print this? Absolutely. It's designed for A4 printing and looks great in colour or black and white. Can I use this in my school or programme? Yes - please contact us about our multi-licence and site licence options.

item.dc:creator: Anne
item.content:encoded:
Objective: Inspire curiosity about engineering and highlight African trailblazers. Lessons:
"What is Engineering?" Definition of engineering, real-world examples (e.g., solar energy, bridges). Activity: Watch videos of African engineers (e.g., Funke Opeke’s internet projects). "Meet the Trailblazers" Profiles of Dr. Wangari Maathai, Funke Opeke, Prof. Tebello Nyokong, and Esther Karwera. Activity: Create a poster or digital collage of their achievements.
